_comment: basis —— 2 英文边界 / 2 现有中文义项，一一对应。这是一对**该保留的相似义项**：raw=0 是「基础（抽象前提）」，raw=1 是「主要成分（具体部分）」。判别句成立。

_oldSenses.reason: 对应英文 raw=0 the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed —— 抽象前提。
对应英文 raw=1 the most important or necessary part of something —— 具体部分。

senses.note: the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed。线索：on the basis of / a sound basis。搭配上几乎只用 on the basis of。
the most important or necessary part of something。线索：the basis of the argument / water is the basis of life。与 s1 的判别句：We act on the basis of evidence.（前提）/ The basis of the problem is poverty.（成因部分）
